reply_text:
I answered Tobias in the thread in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the site was **Southgate**.

Before I read the channel, I checked that he's a member, so this came only from messages he can see himself. On 3 Sep 2025, Pree posted there that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. At 18:43 that day, she posted that labels were printing again and Southgate had cleared the backlog.

I left out a follow-up email from Pree to the customer that names Tulsa. Tobias can't see that email, and it describes a gate check-in screen locking up, not label printing.
